card.name: Slot before an amount used or consumed
card.fires_on: The word or space right before a number or quantity after verbs of using or consuming, such as 'use more' or 'consume about'. It also fires on 'per' after an amount limit.

modes.label: Usage limits
modes.description: The word 'more' or 'per' in a cap on how much of a product to use per week.
modes.example: 18 years and older should not use more than 100 g per week and patients 12 to 17 years should not use<< more>> than 60 g per week.

modes.label: Amount consumed
modes.description: The gap before a number after 'consume', 'uses about' or similar, for resources such as water or drinks.
modes.example: Americans consume<< >>721 bottles and cans of drinks

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about amount used or consumed, such as dose, quantity and consumption.
card.plain: It fires just before a figure saying how much of something is used or consumed.
